# `defer-uses-reassigned-binding`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports a binding reassigned after deferred cleanup captures it by name.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

The defer cleans up the replacement value at scope exit and may leak the
original owner.

## When it fires

It applies when a direct defer target and a later reassignment refer to the same
binding.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");

fn run(allocator: std.mem.Allocator) !void {
    var buf = try allocator.alloc(u8, 8);
    defer allocator.free(buf);
    buf = try allocator.alloc(u8, 16);
}
```
